title: A Master Protocol to Evaluate Therapeutic Activity of Various Agents in Patients With MPN
official: A Master Protocol to Evaluate Therapeutic Activity of Various Agents in Patients With Myeloproliferative Neoplasms (MPN)
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to learn how different treatments work in patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms. The trial will first study how enzomenib affects these patients. Other treatments may be studied later, if needed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has a confirmed pathological diagnosis of PMF or post-PV MF or post-ET MF based on World Health Organization (WHO) diagnostic criteria version 5.0 and classified as intermediate-risk or high-risk based on Dynamic International Prognostic Scoring System (DIPSS)
* Has previously been treated with one or more approved JAK inhibitors for PMF or Post- PV/ET MF and is intolerant, resistant, refractory or has lost response to the JAK inhibitor(s) or is ineligible to be treated with a JAK inhibitor as determined by the Investigator.
* Has a spleen volume ≥450 cm3 by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)/computed tomography (CT) scan, within 2 weeks prior to Cycle 1 Day 1
* Has a total average score of ≥10 using the Myelofibrosis Symptom Assessment Form v4.0
* Fulfills the following clinical laboratory parameters:

  1. Platelet count ≥50 × 109/L without the assistance of growth factors or platelet transfusions
  2. Absolute neutrophil count ≥1 × 109/L without the assistance of growth factors
  3. Hemoglobin ≥10 g/dL
  4. Peripheral blast count \<10%
  5. Serum creatinine ≤1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) or estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (calculated using the CKD-EPI formula)
  6. Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤3 × ULN (ALT and AST ≤5 × ULN if there is liver involvement secondary to myelofibrosis); direct bilirubin ≤2 × ULN; (discuss with Medical Monitor if patient has Gilbert's syndrome)
* Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤2
* Has a life expectancy ≥6 months
* Has a left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50% as determined by echocardiogram (ECHO) within 4 weeks of Cycle 1 Day 1
* Is able to swallow orally administered medication
* Is not of reproductive potential or agrees to use an adequate method of contraception

Exclusion Criteria:

* Is pregnant (as evidenced by self-report or positive pregnancy test), nursing, or planning to become pregnant or nurse during the study period
* Has a medical condition or gastrointestinal tract surgery that could impair absorption or result in short bowel syndrome with diarrhea
* Has received systemic steroid therapy (\>10 mg/day prednisone or equivalent) within 1 week prior to the first dose of study treatment. Topical, inhaled, nasal, and ophthalmic steroids are not prohibited.
* Is currently receiving treatment with a prohibited medication that cannot be discontinued at least 1 week prior to Cycle 1 Day 1
* Has any prior treatment-related toxicity of Grade ≥2 attributed to prior therapy, not disease under study, and considered clinically significant by the investigator (stable Grade 2 may be permitted if discussed with the Sponsor in advance of enrollment)
* Has received previous systemic antineoplastic agents or other experimental therapy within 2 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, prior to the first dose of study intervention or is actively enrolled on another clinical trial.
* Has received splenic irradiation or prior splenectomy
* Has had an allogeneic stem cell transplant within the last 6 months. Note: Patients who have relapsed after 6 months post-transplant and do not have active graft versus host disease are eligible
* Has a history of symptomatic congestive heart failure or myocardial infarction or uncontrolled arrhythmia within 6 months prior to Cycle 1 Day 1
* Has history of ECG abnormalities, clinically significant anemia, active, uncontrolled infections, and chronic or acute viral hepatitis B or C infection.
* Has known intolerance or hypersensitivity reaction to the investigational products or their excipients
